focusedOriginalC.scope: Actual full-main C/JS worlds; native region/actor identity, hero/monster movement membership and real actor creation, overlapping and selection-created cloud/rectangle/member array growth and heap growth, callback expiry/removal and real monster poison effects; complete region/world/visibility bytes, ordered RNG/state and terminal/frame equivalence. Actual nonempty save/release/restore bytes and state also verified; ghost-ID restoration and other advanced branches require separate acceptance.

ordinaryTurns.scope: Real initial walk, wait and forced attack; input through pending output and next read. Generic C field access and pointer-table dispatch are also counted; C malloc includes this runtime's C-stack allocations. Counters are architectural acceptance, not CPU or timing samples.

public44.interpretation: Separate unprofiled single runs. Essentially flat timing; no meaningful overall speedup established.

limits: The 20x ambition and zero-bridge/zero-C-allocation ordinary-turn gate remain unmet.
Persistent regions, pointer-slot storage, addressable locals and strings retain byte representation.
Ghost-ID restoration and other advanced branches remain separately unaccepted.
